name: 103-nested-inline-box
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: builtin_song; font-size: 24px; } p { margin: 8px 0; line-height: 2; } .red { color: #cc0000; } .green { color: #008000; } .box { display: inline-block; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid #666666; background: #eeeeee; } .fixed { width: 60px; } .outer { width: 150px; background: #ddeeff; } .inner { width: 36px; background: #ffcc99; } .small { font-size: .8em; } .half { width: 50%; font-size: .5em; } .empty { height: 18px; }
